item.title: v0.0.0-rc-2
item.description:
What's new

  • Chats keep up with you. A draft you start on one device is waiting on your others; a group opens on the topic you were in; a chat you leave keeps what you were typing.
  • Stopping a photo keeps it. × on a photo that is sending stops it in place; Resume sends only what is missing, also after the app restarts.
  • Your messages stand out. What you send sits in a light block; everyone else's text stays plain.
  • Info has its own column. One way in from the chat header, with the bot's or person's picture at the top.
  • Compacts show their state. A bot's compact shows while it runs and when it ends, also when the bot restarted in the middle.
  • Other channels, one row each. A bot's Telegram channels, groups and chats are listed; open one to read its messages.
  • Select and copy in artifacts, including formulas.
  • Polls and forwarding. A new poll form; silent messages never ring; a forward no longer shows the chat it came from.
  • Share from Finder and Photos sends again.
  • Mac: no more stuck start. An old background process that hangs no longer blocks Tiny Hive from opening.
